name: What happens when I book a handyman repair task?

mainEntity.name: What happens when I book a handyman repair task?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process usually starts with a quick description of the issue, then an on-site assessment if needed, followed by a repair plan and completion. For jobs like door rehanging, drywall patching, cabinet adjustments, or fixture swaps, the key is confirming the scope so the right materials and time are scheduled.
acceptedAnswer.description: You describe the problem, the repair is assessed, the scope is confirmed, and then the work is completed with the needed parts and labor.
